style: Precision MMA & shoot-wrestling counter-striker in a long-sleeve slate-navy ripstop/interlock compression rashguard with ribbed dark slate-charcoal crew-neck collar binding, crimson-burgundy herringbone cotton wrist wraps, open-finger pebbled black leather MMA gloves, charcoal-obsidian ripstop grappling spats, and low-top black leather wrestling shoes
claims: Rigged to the standard Mixamo mixamorig: 65-bone skeleton normalized to meter scale (Armature scale=[1,1,1] with inverseBindMatrices and all 30 required combat animation clips including throw and thrown converted to meters at 1.73m bind-pose height and 52,922 triangles)

Applies analytical two-bone leg IK and flat-foot orientation across fighting_idle (frames 1..99, while preserving frame 0 at exact Mixamo reference stance for lent.js retargeting) and stance clips (block, block_high, crouch) so both feet rest flat on the floor (Foot Y=0.0918m, ToeBase Y=0.0040m, Toe_End Y=0.0032m) with zero heel float or foot sliding

Removes the 6 floating sci-fi spacesuit armor/gadget pods and 3 duplicate opaque eyelash cards from Mesh 0, widens the cylindrical neck (+26% X, +16% Z) via a continuous 3D spatial weight below the jawline, welds the crew-neck collar (Comp 5 d=0..12) smoothly from Comp 0 (dn=1) to the shared d=13 ring via Gaussian angular interpolation, and harmonizes Spine2/Neck/Head skinning weights across the collar seam

Tapers bulky lower-leg boot flares and runs 95 passes of upper-yoke Laplacian smoothing plus 14 cycles of volume-preserving Taubin smoothing across the unified Prim 0 + Prim 1 body manifold to soften recessed 3D sci-fi panel grooves across the torso, pelvis, thighs, knees, calves, and footwear

Splits Mesh 0 into 5 primitives assigned to 5 dedicated glTF 2.0 PBR materials (Ch48_lower_gear, Ch48_skin, Ch48_hair, Ch48_eyes, Ch48_upper_gear) with zero emissive maps: Ch48_skin uses IOR 1.40, roughnessFactor 1.0, normalTexture.scale 1.25, specularFactor 0.38 with warm dermal specularColorFactor [1.0, 0.88, 0.80], warm hemoglobin sheen [0.62, 0.25, 0.16] (sheenRoughnessFactor 0.58), and subtle epidermal lipid clearcoatFactor 0.12 (clearcoatRoughnessFactor 0.28); Ch48_eyes uses IOR 1.38, roughnessFactor 0.031, clearcoatFactor 1.0 (clearcoatRoughnessFactor 0.01), and specularFactor 1.0; Ch48_upper_gear and Ch48_lower_gear use normalTexture.scale 0.65, roughnessFactor 1.0, specularFactor 0.45, and sheenColorFactor [0.18, 0.22, 0.30] (sheenRoughnessFactor 0.55)

Embeds 4096x4096 Ch48_1001_Diffuse and 4096x4096 Ch48_1001_Normal maps plus 2048x2048 PBR maps synthesized by a C CoreGraphics engine: resolved cellular Voronoi sebaceous pores (frequencies 1150 and 1950 with +-18 normal delta and pore-cavity roughness contrast 128..190), straight-ahead hazel-chestnut irises (centers U=0.9462, V=0.3130 and U=0.8686, V=0.3130), anti-aliased ripstop and diagonal twill weave on the slate-navy rashguard and charcoal grappling spats, ribbed dark slate-charcoal crew-neck collar binding, crimson herringbone wrist wraps, and pebbled black leather MMA gloves and wrestling shoes

Includes a custom v3.7 fight brain in brain.js utilizing all 19 arena moves (including throw, takedown, sweep, lowkick, spinkick, knee, onetwo, combo, dodge, and slip) and a custom combat sound effects suite in sfx/
